risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful quantified liquidity, revenue, cost, and securities information and highlights the absence of debt, but it also relies heavily on forward-looking caveats and broad risk-factor language. Liquidity appears adequate currently, though the company has no credit facilities and faces exposure to subscriber demand, cost inflation, execution risk, and potentially inflexible spending.
